title: Two relations in the local Weyl module attached to a multiple of the highest root
author: Bhimarthi Ravinder
work: Demazure Modules, Chari-Venkatesh Modules and Fusion Products
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records two relations in the local Weyl module W((k+1)theta): a power of the lowering operator times a twisted vector annihilates the highest weight vector, and a product of two twisted vectors lies in the submodule generated by a higher one (author lemma at source lines 323-338, label g). The proof (source lines 340-368) proves the first relation by a complete commutator computation: it replaces a raising operator applied to a high power of a lowering operator by the commutator, expands it as a sum, substitutes the explicit commutator with the Cartan element, simplifies to a non-zero multiple of the desired vector and uses the vanishing of a high power (proof lines 341-364); the second relation is obtained by specialising the article's labelled commutation relation (proof lines 365-367). The commutator computation is the content. H3.
